text: Hb-Manitoba was discovered in 1970 [1] in a Canadian family of British origin. Recently, we observed the same variant in a second family, and found that the oxy-derivative of Hb-Manitoba is slightly unstable at 65 degrees Celsius, dissociating less readily at acidic pH than does Hb-A, and forming asymmetric hybrids with other hemoglobins which are readily detectable by electrophoresis.
